name: Design
intro: Designers who make your product, site and brand look right and work right, from UX to motion.

roleDetails.text: Researches how people use your product and designs the screens and flows that make it easy to use.
Owns design for product features from first sketch to final handoff, working closely with your engineers.
Creates marketing assets, social graphics, presentations and print pieces that stay on brand.
Designs and updates website and landing pages, often building them in tools like Webflow or WordPress.
Builds and maintains your visual identity: logos, type, color and the guidelines that keep it consistent.
Edits video and creates motion graphics for ads, social posts and product content.
